sanskrit_verse: दाक्षायणी ब्रह्मसूत्री वेणुमान सकमण्डलुः । कुर्यात् प्रदक्षिणं देवमृगोविप्रवनस्पतीन् ॥
transliteration: dākṣāyaṇī brahmasūtrī veṇumān sakamaṇḍaluḥ | kuryāt pradakṣiṇaṃ devamṛdgovipravanaspatīn ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who is devoted to Dakshayani, adorned with the sacred thread, holding a staff and water pot, shall perform circumambulation of the divine, the cow, the Brahmin, and the sacred trees.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority through devotion establishes lawful conduct
Causation arises from ritual alignment with divine order
Capacity-based responsibility flows from spiritual readiness
Restoration logic embedded in ceremonial repetition
Consciousness alignment achieved via symbolic acts
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent holds symbols of renunciation AND performs circumambulation THEN agent fulfills dharmic observance
IF entity is designated as divine, cow, Brahmin, or sacred tree THEN it must be included in pradakshina protocol
IF individual engages in ritual without proper implements THEN capacity deficit recorded for rectification
IF observance aligns with cosmic rhythm THEN restoration of balance is automatically registered
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters involving religious practice, the court must recognize that fulfillment of dharma is not measured by external compliance alone but by internal alignment with the symbols and sequence prescribed. The presence of implements like staff and water pot indicates readiness, which determines threshold of responsibility.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Through pramana-based observation, the act of pradakshina is seen as causally linked to consciousness elevation. Each step taken in sequence reflects anupurvasah—manifesting harmony. Responsibility is proportional to awareness of symbolism. There is no punitive element; misalignment merely delays integration until correction occurs naturally.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Re-enactment of full circumambulation upon recognition of omission
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Voluntary reaffirmation of symbolic items before continuation
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Guided re-introduction to meaning behind each element
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Witnessed repetition affirming connection between action and consciousness
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ordinance stands established. Dharma is restored through conscious enactment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator.
